examples.text: Critics rhapsodized about the young pianist's debut, calling it the most thrilling performance of the decade.

origin.ko: rhapsody에 동사 접미사 -ize가 붙었습니다. 서사시 낭송자처럼 열광적으로 말한다는 뜻입니다.

senses.en: An exaggeratedly enthusiastic or exalted expression of feeling in speech or writing.

examples.text: Her review was a rhapsody of praise for the restored cathedral and its luminous windows.

senses.en: (music) a free instrumental composition in one extended movement; typically emotional or exuberant in character

examples.text: The orchestra closed the evening with a lush rhapsody built on folk melodies.

origin.ko: 그리스어 rhapsōidia(서사시 낭송)에서 왔고, '노래를 꿰매 잇다'라는 이미지가 열광적 표현으로 바뀌었습니다.

senses.en: Meaningless language with an exaggerated style intended to impress.

examples.text: Voters grew tired of campaign rhetoric that promised sweeping change but offered no concrete plans.

senses.en: using language effectively to please or persuade

examples.text: Aristotle's treatise on rhetoric remains a foundation for the study of persuasion.

origin.ko: 그리스어 rhētorikē(연설가의 기술)에서 왔습니다. 말솜씨가 알맹이 없는 미사여구라는 뜻으로도 쓰입니다.
